claims.evidence: 15 raws x 3 SILAC states = 45 rows. Each medium/heavy source = one pulse-labelled K562 culture whose lysate went into exactly one combined mix (PRIDE protocol: 'Lysates from equal counts of the heavy and the medium cells were combined'), so names are unique per run. The light channel of each run = pre-existing (unlabelled) proteins of the two combined cultures; it gets its own source name per run (validation.md:22-23) and characteristics[pooled sample] SN= lists the two cultures it came from. These light names are not aliquots of one physical pool shared across runs: each run's light material comes only from that run's two cultures.

claims.value: SILAC light / SILAC medium / SILAC heavy
claims.evidence: summary.txt Multiplicity=3, Labels0 empty, Labels1 Arg6;Lys4, Labels2 Arg10;Lys8 (LMH searches); MH search multiplicity 2 Arg6;Lys4 | Arg10;Lys8. PRIDE protocol: heavy 13C6,15N2 Lys (#88209) + 13C6,15N4 Arg (#89990); medium 4,4,5,5-D4 Lys (#88437) + 13C6 Arg (#88210). Light rows kept because the primary search quantified light (M/L, H/L ratios) and the light state is the pre-existing proteome (QuaNCAT precedent PXD005059 in sdrf-annotated-datasets).

claims.value: medium = normoxia mono-culture (N); heavy = hypoxia co-culture with HS-5 (CO); light = not applicable (pre-existing proteins of both)
claims.evidence: PRIDE data processing: 'Raw files corresponding to 3 replicate samples obtained from K562 cells cultured for 72h in N and CO conditions were processed together' = txt_search_LMH_pp2_1 (pp2_1c,1d,1e). Explicit label source: Table S1 columns 'Ratio CoCult/Norm A/B/C' equal log2(Ratio H/M normalized 1c/1d/1e) exactly for 2126/2085/2009 of 2126/2085/2009 proteins (orientation.txt section 1) => heavy=CoCult, medium=Norm. claims.location: factor value[genetic modification] / characteristics[genetic modification], PP_1*,PP_2*,PP_4*,PP_5* rows
claims.value: PP_1: M=shNEG N, H=shTIAR N; PP_2: M=shTIAR CO, H=shNEG CO; PP_4: M=shNEG N, H=shFMRP N; PP_5: M=shFMRP CO, H=shNEG CO
claims.evidence: PRIDE data processing lists four pairs (1. shNEG/shTIAR N; 2. shNEG/shTIAR CO; 3. shNEG/shFMRP N; 4. shNEG/shFMRP CO) x 3 replicates searched together = experiments 1,2,4,5 x A,B,C in summary.txt. Neither the deposit nor the paper names which experiment number is which pair or which state carried which cells, so the map was taken from the deposited Table S2 values: mean log2 H/M normalized of experiment 1 correlates r=+0.995 with 'in shTIAR_N' (median |diff| 0.013), exp2 r=-0.957 with 'in shTIAR_CO', exp4 r=+0.990 with 'in shFMRP_N' (median |diff| 0.009), exp5 r=-0.974 with 'in shFMRP_CO'; all other column-experiment pairs |r|<=0.75 (orientation.txt section 2). Table S2 is shRBP vs shNEG (Fig 7 legend), so positive r => heavy=shRBP, negative r => medium=shRBP. Independent check: TIAL1 (TIAR) H/M 0.15-0.43 in 1A-1C (heavy = shTIAR knockdown) and 2.47 in 2C (heavy = shNEG), ~1 in exps 4/5. The experiment numbering 1,2,4,5 follows the order of the four pairs in the PRIDE text. FMR1 was not quantified as its own protein group (only grouped with FXR1/FXR2), so FMRP orientation rests on Table S2 alone.

limitations: Which experiment number (1,2,4,5) is which shNEG/shRBP pair, and which SILAC state carried which cells, is stated nowhere in words; it was derived by matching deposited proteinGroups ratios against the authors' supplementary Table S2 (r=+0.995/-0.957/+0.990/-0.974) and corroborated by TIAL1 knockdown ratios for the TIAR pairs. FMR1 was not quantified as its own protein group, so the FMRP pair orientation rests on Table S2 alone. The pp2 (N vs CO) orientation has an exact Table S1 match.

Whether the shNEG cells paired with shTIAR and with shFMRP in the same replicate experiment were one culture split in two or two separate cultures is not stated; biological replicate is numbered by independent experiment (A/B/C = 1/2/3, 'Results from 3 independent experiments'), so shNEG rows of PP_1x and PP_4x (and PP_2x/PP_5x) share replicate numbers but have distinct source names (distinct combined mixes).
Whether K562 cells were separated from the HS-5 stroma before the 4 h pulse/lysis in the CO condition is not stated; the CO rows may contain HS-5 proteins.
comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available (no mqpar.xml); parse_sdrf convert-openms therefore exits 1, as for campaign precedents PXD014368/PXD006676.

The pp2 search (txt_search_LMH_pp2_1) was run with MaxQuant 1.6.17.0 while PRIDE/paper state v2.0.3.0 (true only for the 1245 searches); modification and tolerance settings are identical, so one SDRF covers both.

The 12 PP_* raws were searched twice (LMH multiplicity 3 and MH multiplicity 2, re-quantify on); both searches use the same modifications, so one set of rows describes them; the light rows describe the LMH search's light state.
parse_sdrf warns that characteristics[pooled sample] 'SN=...;SN=...' is not an allowed value; the SN= pattern is licensed by TERMS.tsv/spec README.adoc:352 and the validator exits 0.
characteristics[genetic modification], [growth condition] and [protein population] are custom characteristics columns (spec 'Extending Templates').
